source: Admin Console User, Role, and Resource Permission API Documentation.md

departmentId.description: Direct-department filter, without descendant recursion. Omit for all; 0 queries only direct members of the root department.

page.description: Page number; examples start at 1; frontend pageIndex+1; no @Min in source

nickname.description: Bean @NotBlank; no backend @Size; UI trims and enforces 1..100; NotBlank(message = "{required.parameter.error}")

username.description: Bean @NotBlank; business maximum 100 characters; disallows path-reserved characters (backslash, slash, colon, asterisk, question mark, double quote, angle brackets, vertical bar) and duplicate usernames; NotBlank(message = "{required.parameter.error}")

departmentIdList.description: Optional; null/[] defaults to root department 0; deduplicated; department existence is not explicitly checked here

systemRoleIdList.description: Optional; null/[] or all-null defaults to system role 0; filters nulls and deduplicates; effective roles must exist

userPermissionIdList.description: Optional; omitted/null saves []; elements must be 114001/114002, with null/invalid elements rejected; valid entries are deduplicated

jobTitle.description: Optional string; no explicit length validation

leaderId.description: Optional BigInteger; no explicit existence check in this endpoint

email.description: Optional; nonempty values require regex-valid email and length <=320

tenantIdList.description: Optional; always adds shared organization 0, then appends requested organizations with deduplication; organization-space membership, not system roles

personalAssets.description: Optional; created by default even when omitted; if provided, enabled must be true; Valid

personalBase.description: Optional; omission does not create it; if provided, enabled=true and name@NotBlank. At creation, request tenant-id must be an organization containing this user; Valid

userPermissionIdList.description: User-level permission IDs; only 114001 (bulk read) and 114002 (bulk set)

personalAssets.description: Personal asset-space configuration; created by default when omitted; Valid

personalBase.description: Personal multidimensional-table database configuration; omitted means no creation; Valid

user_update.title: Update an account and its department/system-role associations

id.description: Target user is required by business semantics; VO lacks @NotNull, but callers must provide a valid ID rather than assume omission is safe

username.description: null preserves the original; nonempty values use creation validation. Blank checks may be skipped and blank values written; external callers must supply valid usernames.

departmentIdList.description: Each update deletes old associations; missing/null/[] returns to root department 0; nonempty values fully replace with deduplication

systemRoleIdList.description: Only nonempty arrays trigger full replacement; omitted/null/[] preserves old roles. This endpoint does not reuse creation's role-existence validation.

email.description: Missing/null writes null; nonempty values must be valid email <=320 characters

ssoUserId.description: Writes and checks duplicates only for nonblank values; legacy field, not independent SSO-binding management

userPermissionIdList.description: Omitted/null preserves; [] clears; nonempty validates 114001/114002 then replaces

personalAssets.description: Omission still creates personal space automatically for users without it; Valid

personalBase.description: Omission does not enable it; already enabled resources are not recreated; false cannot disable it; Valid

user_reset_password.title: Administratively reset a regular account's password

userId.description: Target account ID; platform administrator accounts cannot be reset

withUser.description: Only true includes each department's direct userList; omitted/false does not query members

name.description: @NotBlank; must not be blank. No explicit backend length/duplicate-name validation; the UI also checks nonempty input. NotBlank(message = "{required.parameter.error}")

parentId.description: @NotNull; use 0 for the root department; parent existence is not explicitly validated. NotNull(message = "{required.parameter.error}")

leaderId.description: Optional BigInteger; user membership/existence is not explicitly validated

department_update.title: Rename, move, or set a department leader

name.description: Optional; writes non-null values; no explicit nonblank/length/duplicate validation

parentId.description: Optional destination parent ID for moves; the UI disallows self/descendants and moving root 0; the backend does not enforce these business checks

leaderId.description: Optional selected leader user ID; the UI selects from this department's paginated users; the backend does not verify membership

oldPassword.description: Raw current password string, not a precomputed hash

newPassword.description: Raw new password; at least 8 characters, including uppercase/lowercase letters, digits, and special characters

password_update.unsupported: Only Session or first-party USER_JWT supports password updates. OAuth2 and personal tokens are rejected; use platform personal settings.
